reasons: The supported enforcement subset omits known third/fourth-down extensions; an ordinary subset result can misleadingly label the whole game Fair.
Expected-point impact can be extreme in low-leverage situations and does not establish outcome-changing interference.
Only 33.5% of accepted penalties in the reserved 2024/2025 seasons were valued; 96 of 544 games were unrated.
decision: Keep the implemented candidate available for offline and isolated integration evaluation. Do not publish containers or promote it to the live site until these issues are resolved and a new evaluation is reviewed.
